vocabulary.approve: Approve = one checker's recorded decision; it is not ALLOW and it is not Activate
vocabulary.activate: Activate = the scope's policy head changes at the time it was published for
vocabulary.developmentComplete: Development Complete ≠ Release Enabled: approving or publishing in the Console does not enable provider traffic

common.waitingServer: Waiting for the server to confirm…

message.outcomeUnknown: We can't tell whether the command was saved, so it is on hold: load the canonical state, then resend only the same command.
message.approvalStale: Approval authority or scope has changed (authorization epoch mismatch). Load the current scope and approve again.
message.versionConflict: The data was changed elsewhere{{versions}}. The system does not merge edits automatically: load the canonical version before deciding again.
message.headConflict: The scope's policy head is not what was expected, and the system does not pick a winner: load the current head, then test and approve again.
message.idempotencyConflict: This command was already sent with different content, so it will not be resent: load the state and start a new command.
message.selfApproval: The requester cannot approve their own request.
message.duplicateChecker: This checker has already decided on this revision.
message.delegation: Delegated authority cannot be used for an item at this level.
message.forbidden: Your current permissions do not cover this command.
message.notFound: This item was not found, or it is outside the permissions you can access.
message.unavailable: Governance is not responding right now and the system fails closed: the command's outcome is unknown. Load the canonical state, then resend only the same command.

guardrails.title: 🔒 Guardrails that cannot be overridden
guardrails.body: DNC · purpose objection · consent/lawful basis · explicit preference BLOCK/DEFER · kill switch · rules with overridable=false — no command on this page can bypass them

evidence.label: Evidence reference
evidence.hint: Enter an opaque reference only, such as an internal ticket number — never a customer's name, phone number or email.

reason.label: Reason code
reason.hint: A controlled reason code, for example COMPLIANCE_WITHDRAWN

openById.legend: Open an item by opaque ID
openById.error: Only opaque IDs (UUID) are accepted — do not search by name, phone number or email

overview.title: Contact Governance
overview.backToQueue: Back to the exception queue for contact {{id}}

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.empty: Open the queue from a Contact or an Exception series with an opaque ID

case.select: Select an item from the queue

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.redacted: Evidence details can be opened only by users with Compliance permission, and every access is audited

checker.title: Maker–Checker
checker.serverChecks: · the server checks quorum by risk tier on every save
checker.readOnly: This view shows the summary only; you cannot approve or revoke

dialog.decisionBody: Bound to revision {{revision}} · digest {{digest}} · contact version {{version}} — the server rejects the command if anything changes in the meantime
dialog.revokeBody: Revoke takes effect as soon as it commits, and pending work is re-authorized — a new approval must be a new series
dialog.cancelBody: Only requests still awaiting a decision can be cancelled, and the full history is kept

message.quorumMet: Quorum met ({{current}}/{{required}}) — the exception is APPROVED, which is not yet ALLOW: the runtime decides on every actual send
message.recorded: Approval recorded (quorum {{current}}/{{required}}) — not yet ALLOW and not yet Activate
message.rejected: This revision was rejected. The history remains append-only
message.revoked: Revoked ({{state}}) — pending work will be re-authorized and nothing resumes automatically

policies.title: Policies
policies.empty: Open a policy series with an opaque ID
policies.heading: Policy {{id}}

message.approved: Approval recorded (quorum {{current}}/{{required}}, {{state}}) — Approve is not the same as Activate
message.published: Publish committed ({{state}}{{activate}}) — downstream will re-authorize pending work from the event; the Console has no acknowledgement query yet, so it does not claim the change has fully propagated
message.rollback: Rollback candidate v{{version}} created — a rollback is a new version that must be tested and approved again; the original row is not switched back

headMismatch.title: ⚠ Policy head changed after testing
headMismatch.body: The test result is bound to head v{{base}} ({{baseDigest}}) but the current head is v{{current}} ({{currentDigest}}) — test and approve again; the system does not pick a winner

diff.title: Changes compared with the active head

kill.title: ⛔ A kill switch is active in this scope
kill.body: A relaxing publish is blocked until it is cleared with another person's approval, and clearing does not resume earlier work

release.title: Release packet
release.noArtifact: No test artifact yet — test before approving

dialog.decisionBody: Bound to content {{content}} · test artifact {{artifact}} · head v{{head}} — {{vocabulary}}
dialog.activateAtHint: Used once quorum is met — you still need to publish before it takes effect
dialog.publishBody: Change the scope's policy head from v{{head}} according to approval {{digest}}
dialog.rollbackBody: Create a new version from the content of v{{version}}. It must be tested, approved and published again from scratch

audit.title: Audit
audit.toWorkspace: Go to this item's approval workspace
audit.toStudio: Go to this item's policy studio
audit.empty: Open the trace of an exception or policy with an opaque ID

safety.title: Safety case
safety.rollbackValue: Always creates a new version; never edits a published row
